name: Should I replace or reface my mobile home kitchen cabinets during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace or reface my mobile home kitchen cabinets during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to replace or reface your mobile home kitchen cabinets depends on their current condition, your budget, and desired outcome. Refacing is a more economical and quicker option if the existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound, offering a fresh look with new doors, drawer fronts, and veneer. Replacing cabinets is suitable for significant layout changes, addressing structural issues, or if you desire a completely new style and configuration. We can assess your current cabinetry and recommend the best approach for your renovation goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reface cabinets if boxes are sound for a quick refresh. Replace them for layout changes or structural issues. Your budget and desired outcome are key factors.
